artifacts.summary: Measured negative result on content-based OCR-misrecognition detection (four signal families, 11 scan-pipeline positives vs 6 born-digital controls, none separated); implemented the provenance-only fallback instead (shared scan_pipeline_provenance() function, deduplicated fidelity-audit consumer, non-blocking conversion-time ADVISORY, negative result written into repository docs).

completion_data.completion_summary: Implemented the provenance-only fallback for the literature quality gate's OCR/scan-source signal after confirming (four measurement rounds, 11 scan-pipeline positives vs 6 born-digital dense-math controls) that a content-based OCR-misrecognition detector is not viable on this corpus. Promoted the existing Creator/Producer regex into an importable scan_pipeline_provenance() in literature_quality_gate.py, deduplicated literature-fidelity-audit.sh's own copy to consume it, added a non-blocking ADVISORY stderr line to literature-convert.sh's quality gate, added 9 self-test fixtures plus 6 new test-literature-convert.sh assertions, and recorded the negative result with its decisive numbers in literature-organization.md and provenance-fidelity.md.

memory_candidates.content: When a shared regex/constant is promoted from a hand-duplicated inline copy into a shared module function, grep for the OLD symbol name across the whole repo (not just the direct consumer) before declaring the dedup complete -- a docstring/comment in the NEW module that explains the promotion by literally citing the old symbol name (for historical continuity) is itself a residual hit against a 'grep returns nothing' verification check. Rephrase such comments to describe the prior state without literally repeating the retired identifier.

For a behavior-preserving refactor of a classifier/gate function (e.g. moving a check's logic into a shared module without changing its inputs/outputs), capture a pre-edit baseline of the classifier's full verdict-count distribution (not just spot-checking a few inputs) and re-run the identical command post-edit to diff the two distributions. A single unchanged summary count (e.g. 'unverified_scan_source: 11' before and after) is strong, cheap evidence the move introduced no behavior change, and is far cheaper than unit-testing every classification path directly.
